title: metadata: after a package-less write of an action name, the host package comes back as a phantom holder in the bare read (the boot pass's host stamp on a stored row; follow-up of #32791)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32791 (PR #32802). Finding S2 of PR #32802's contract review (6835430791). The epic #31527 seat ruled it its own card on the release line, p1. Dispatch it after PR #32676 (card #32521) has merged, because the preferred fix touches that PR's boot-pass guard (D1).

## What moves

Composition of #32791 (one package `com.alpha.app` holds the action name in a stored row, a package-less stored row of the name is saved last, the host declares `com.host.app`). PR #32802 corrects the bare read right after the boot pass. After one package-less write it is wrong again:

| Step after the boot pass | Before #32560 | `main` and PR #32802's head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `register('action', 'helper', body)` with no package, then the bare read | the written body | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming `com.host.app`, `com.alpha.app` and the environment |
| `registerInMemory` of a package-less item, then the bare read | the item | the same `409` |

It fails closed (a refusal, no widening, no silent pick), but it names a holder that does not exist (ADR-0150 red line 2), and #32791's TO holds only for the state right after the boot pass.

## Design direction (epic seat)

- **Preferred (B):** at the boot priming pass, do not give the host's stamp to a package-less stored row. The phantom then never forms, and the bare read and bare removal agree again (PR #32802's review records that they disagree in this composition today).
- **Alternative (A):** keep the stamp and correct the count at read time after writes too, as PR #32802 does for the boot state.

## Owed

1. Pick B unless measurement shows it moves another answer; say why if A is chosen.
2. Pin both rows above red on `main` and green after, and the bare-removal agreement in the same composition.
3. Re-measure the nine by-package types in the same composition; declare any moved answer FROM → TO.
4. Changeset with the moved answers.

Restart-when: none, this card is on the epic #31527 release line (ruling 6824949405 on #31527); dispatch after PR #32676 merges.
